body:
commands.py:298-319: cmd_claim loops over issue IDs, committing each claim as it goes. If a later ID is unclaimable (SystemExit from update_issue), earlier claims are already committed but nothing is printed about them and auto-push is skipped.

Fix: pre-validate claimability of ALL ids (exists, state open, ready) before the first mutation so the command either claims everything or nothing. No transaction machinery needed — just an upfront check loop.
title: Make multi-ID claim validate all IDs before first mutation
